title: The Coronary Artery Calcium and Troponins in Rheumatoid Arthritis (CAT-RA) Study
official: The Coronary Artery Calcium and Troponins in Rheumatoid Arthritis (CAT-RA) Study
summary: Individuals with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) have up to 2x the risk of having a heart attack compared to someone without RA. The goal of this study is to identify biomarkers that can help us do a better job of identifying individuals at risk before they develop symptoms of heart disease and start preventative treatment earlier.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* RA diagnosed by a rheumatologist
* Age 40- 79
* ≥1 ASCVD risk factor including prediabetes, hypertension, BMI \>30, current or history of cigarette smoking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients on a statin or with a contraindication to statin, on a cholesterol absorption inhibitor, or on a PCSK9 inhibitor
* Patients with diabetes mellitus
* Pregnancy
